description.short_caption: Gram stain of CSF showing gram-positive cocci in pairs and clusters.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a Gram stain of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). Numerous gram-positive cocci are visible, arranged in pairs and small clusters. The organisms appear dark against a lighter background, consistent with the Gram staining technique. This finding is suggestive of a bacterial infection, potentially involving organisms such as Streptococcus pneumoniae or Staphylococcus species.
visible_findings: dark staining against a light background
